paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -4.54% on average, with DAX strongest (-3.47%) and Dow Jones weakest (-6.12%). Brent crude changed -6.02% to 90.05. Gold changed -6.62% to 3,627.8999. Bitcoin changed -3.40% to 61,949.6211. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.052%, a relative move of -1.00%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-18.74%) and BHP (-14.86%) moved the most.
